titulo.alumno: A return rule · Shopping, returns and warranty

intro: Part 2: a return rule. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

texto: When reading a return policy, separate the time limit, the condition the item must be in and the proof of purchase. «Hvis» can introduce a condition; the word order of the sentence depends on whether it is a main or a subordinate clause.
Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.
